import narwhals as nw
from narwhals.typing import IntoDataFrame

def reshape_wide_to_long(df: IntoDataFrame) -> IntoDataFrame:
    """Reshape DataFrame from wide to long format."""
    df = nw.from_native(df)
    
    result = df.unpivot(
        index="id",
        on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
        variable_name="month",
        value_name="sales"
    )
    
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pandas as pd
    
    wide_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "id": [1, 2, 3],
        "jan": [100, 200, 150],
        "feb": [120, 210, 160],
        "mar": [130, 220, 170]
    })
    
    long_df = reshape_wide_to_long(wide_df)
    print(long_df.to_native())
